## [1.6.0](https://github.com/danieleavolio/lovaion-patches/compare/v1.5.0...v1.6.0) (2026-11-06)

### ✨ New Features

* **rarecam:** add Rarecam Pro unlock patch ([2e08bf6](https://github.com/danieleavolio/lovaion-patches/commit/2e08bf64f40a6ce44219e80513837ec3540c1fc8))

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the premium entitlement to always resolve as active, hides the feed's premium activation banner, shows the active plan as MORHPE in the profile and disables the app's over-the-air updates, which would otherwise replace the patched bundle on the next launch.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check so a re-signed build of Photon Camera starts instead of being refused. Required by every other patch.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the premium entitlement to always resolve as active, unlocking the VIP LUT packs, the AI photo review and the LUT Creator, with or without a Play purchase and with or without a network connection.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks the premium subscription, its song catalog and practice tools, and skips the subscription screen the app shows on launch.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check so a re-signed build of Rare starts instead of being refused. Required by every other patch.

patches.name: Unlock Rarecam Pro
patches.description: Forces the Rarecam Pro entitlement to always resolve as active, unlocking the Pro looks, the custom 3D LUT import, the S-Log3 and 16-bit TIFF export, unlimited Mist, Bayer RAW (DNG) saving and multi-frame RAW Stack capture, with or without a Play purchase and with or without a network connection.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license check so a re-signed build of Tickdrop starts instead of being refused. Required by every other patch.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Forces the Plus entitlement to always resolve as active, unlocking the premium skins, the unlimited tasks, pinning and backup.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Forces the Pro entitlement to always resolve as active, regardless of purchase or backend status.
